evidence: The Bragg punch's node test (integer_detect="significance", the default: src/nebula3d/pipeline.py:464) takes a node's background from the median of the measured voxels between 1× and 2× the resolution ellipsoid R (0.097, 0.072, 0.115 Å⁻¹: pipeline.py:566). With fewer than 8 of them it returns no shell (src/nebula3d/analysis/bragg.py:1818) and the test falls back, silently, on the window's median (bragg.py:1746-1748), and the width test then reads the node as no broader than a Bragg peak (bragg.py:1864, :1872-1873). On the validation's dev crystal at n=81 (0.161 Å⁻¹ a voxel) the shell holds 2 to 6 voxels at 96 % of the nodes (703 of 728 on dev-control), and the window's median passes the diffuse at a node: at the forbidden (1,1,0), a saddle of the diffuse, the window's brightest voxel sits at its corner and reads 6.1σ over the window's median (the threshold 5.86), so the node is punched. On the punch's input at n=81 the test punches 29 to 106 forbidden nodes per dev case without rings (118 and 125 on the ring cases), a quarter to a half of the punched voxels, all diffuse on the cases without rings; the ⟨3/2 0 0⟩ amplitude ratio falls to 0.77–0.79 on dev-control, dev-ub and dev-flatten, which fail the features criterion (0.89–0.93 without the forbidden punches). At n=161 every node's shell holds 9 voxels or more.
proposed_fix: A per-node guard on the node test: the R..2R shell must hold at least 8 measured voxels, the test's own floor (named _SHELL_MIN_VOXELS, shared with the width test), counted at each node around the voxel judged, since the count varies with the direction of Q and with the mask. Below it the test does not judge the node, with no fallback: with mode "both" (the default) it is left to the search pass, which judges it by strength, and a search peak inside the window of a node left to it (the box the node test searches about the node) is that node's Bragg peak, the brightest if there are more: recorded with the node as source_node_hkl and found_by "search" (the node test's peaks say "integer"), and punched and learned from like the node test's peaks, the Bragg profile included (Bragg peaks the search cannot see may remain: below its floors, the lesser error, or in a |Q| shell too thin for it); with mode "integer" the test as it was is kept and marked provisional. Said out loud wherever the punch stage reports, opening with GRID_TOO_COARSE: the done line of its run log ends on "⚠ grid too coarse for the Bragg punch's node test: a voxel is <v> Å⁻¹; its background shell needs ≤ <limit> Å⁻¹. N of M nodes were not judged and were left to the search pass; Bragg peaks the search cannot see may remain. Use a finer grid." (mode "integer": "… N of M nodes were judged provisionally, against their window's median; diffuse maxima at nodes may be punched. Use a finer grid."), its line on the integer nodes counts them on any grid, and its record (the profile JSON, node_test) keeps them, served by GET /api/bragg/{id}/profile and the bridge's bragg_profile_json. The limit is derived from R and the floor: the shell's Q-volume is (28π/3)·rρ·rθ·rφ, so 8 voxels need a voxel Q-volume of (7π/6)·rρ·rθ·rφ or less, 0.143 Å⁻¹ a cubic voxel at the default R, about 2·r_min (BraggRemover.node_test_limit). On a grid finer than the limit, nodes at the edge of the measured volume or on the box's faces whose shell falls short are counted on the integer nodes' line without the ⚠ notice.

note: Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19; the search-peak rule approved with it, the same day, for the two n=81 replay failures the guard alone caused, and in 887ce72. At n=81 no forbidden node is punched on any dev case (the ring cases' four and two on the planted 4.05 Å⁻¹ ring, which the ring removal leaves at that grid (G1), aside), dev-control, dev-ub and dev-flatten keep 0.89–0.93 of the ⟨3/2 0 0⟩ amplitude, and broad maxima planted at the 12 (1,1,0) nodes go unpunched (12 of 12 with the test as it was). The guard alone left the Bragg peaks at the 703 nodes to the search as peaks off any node: the punch learned no Bragg profile from the 8 nodes the test judged, so the peaks whose own width it could not measure got the bare resolution ellipsoid, the fills' texture was judged at n=81 and flagged, and grain_check read the peaks at the nodes as displaced (on dev-control: UB off by 0°). With the rule the search's 172 peaks on dev-control are the Bragg peaks of nodes left to it, the profile is learned from 180 peaks (172 of them the search's), the ΔPDF scores as with the forbidden nodes' punches simply taken out (⟨3/2 0 0⟩ 0.926, rms error 0.266), and the console's known answers at n=81 hold. At n=161 nothing is left to the search: the punch's records, holes and log are as before, and arm A on dev is unchanged. Left open: at n=81 the search misses the Bragg peaks at the box's corners (±4, ±4, ±4), whose |Q| shell holds under its 20 voxels; the notice reaches the Pilot through run_log only. decision.option: a per-node guard: ≥ 8 measured voxels in the R..2R shell; below it the node is left to the search pass, with a notice
